title.fr_fr: Déchets nucléaires à vie longue décomposés

content.en_us:
How to get it :
- Crafting table : 9 x [[gv:nuclear_waste_long_depleted_tiny_neptunium|Tiny Pile of Decayed Long-Lived Nuclear Waste]].
- [[Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum|Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum]] : [[gv:nuclear_waste_long_neptunium|Long-Lived Nuclear Waste]].

Used to make :
[[gv:nuclear_waste_long_depleted_tiny_neptunium|Tiny Pile of Decayed Long-Lived Nuclear Waste]], [[Uranium-238|Uranium-238 Nugget]], [[gv:dust_tiny|Tiny Pile of Dust]], [[gv:nuclear_waste_tiny|Tiny Pile of Nuclear Waste]].
